title: Hermes MCP additions — approval-gated manifest
rule: No entry is installed or run until Evan approves its phase. Credential-bearing values are entered at approval time only, never stored here.

entries.name: obsidian
entries.posture: Read-only. Reads scoped to approved folders. Never expose the entire synced vault.
prerequisites: Obsidian Local REST API plugin (separate approval)
Environment configuration (separate approval; no credential stored here)

entries.name: n8n
entries.posture: Documentation tools only. No n8n instance URL, no API credential. Management mode stays off.
entries.command: hermes mcp add n8n --command 'env MCP_MODE=stdio LOG_LEVEL=error DISABLE_CONSOLE_OUTPUT=true npx n8n-mcp'

entries.name: yahoo-finance
entries.posture: Research and idea generation only. Verify prices, timestamps, adjustments, and options fields before relying on outputs. Never execution-grade.

entries.name: openbb
entries.posture: Evaluate in a separate environment as research-only data. Not a one-command Hermes MCP.
entries.command: uv venv .venv-openbb && . .venv-openbb/bin/activate && uv pip install openbb

entries.name: composio
entries.posture: Revisit only with a named connector use case and a least-privilege plan. One low-impact app, read-only scopes, never a broad account bundle.

entries.name: activepieces
entries.posture: Compare against existing n8n needs before adding a second automation platform. If tested: sandbox workspace, one low-risk connector.

entries.name: memory-reference
entries.posture: Isolated experiment with non-sensitive data only. Not canonical memory. Duplicates Hermes/Obsidian memory.
